Description:

Welcome to sophisticated urban living at Domus – a desirable residence ideally situated in the heart of Yaletown. This beautifully furnished 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers approximately 1,024 sqft of thoughtfully designed living space, combining contemporary style, comfort, and convenience.
The home is fully furnished with sleek, modern pieces and quality finishes, creating a turnkey living experience. The open-concept layout maximizes space and natural light while providing a comfortable setting for relaxing, dining, or entertaining.
With two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the residence provides a functional layout well suited for professionals, couples, or those looking for additional space in one of Downtown Vancouver’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

Key Features:

• Spacious Layout – Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms across approximately 1,024 sqft.
• Fully Furnished – Contemporary furnishings and quality finishes throughout.
• Open-Concept Living – Thoughtfully designed to maximize space and natural light.
• Convenient Amenities – Access to a fitness centre, entertainment room, and guest suite.
• Parking – Free parking included.
Building Amenities:
• Fully equipped fitness centre
• Entertainment room & resident lounge
• Guest suite available
• Bike locker

Location Perks:

Live in Yaletown, one of Vancouver’s most desirable neighborhoods:
✔ Steps from Yaletown’s renowned restaurants and cafés
✔ Close to boutique shops, markets, and everyday conveniences
✔ Moments from the Seawall and waterfront
✔ Convenient access to Downtown Vancouver
✔ Vibrant, highly walkable neighborhood

To arrange a private viewing, please contact Yael
